For \(1\le n\le 24\), \(a_n>0\), so \(S_n>0\). Also \(a_{25}=0\), so \(S_{25}>0\).

For \(j=1,\dots,24\),
\[
a_j+a_{50-j}
=\frac{\sin(j\pi/25)}{j}+\frac{\sin((50-j)\pi/25)}{50-j}
=\sin\left(\frac{j\pi}{25}\right)\left(\frac1j-\frac1{50-j}\right)>0.
\]
Thus
\[
S_{50}=\sum_{j=1}^{24}(a_j+a_{50-j})>0.
\]

For \(26\le n\le 49\), the tail \(a_{n+1}+\cdots+a_{50}\le 0\), so
\[
S_n=S_{50}-(a_{n+1}+\cdots+a_{50})\ge S_{50}>0.
\]
Hence all \(S_1,S_2,\dots,S_{50}\) are positive.

\[
\boxed{50}
\]
